mapper.sql: ID, DOC_TYPE, DOC_NUMBER, TITLE, REVISION_NO, REVISION_DATE, DOC_OWNER AS OWNER, FILE_LINK, NOTE, TAGS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT
mapper.update: UPDATE COMPANY_DOCUMENTS SET DOC_TYPE = #{docType}, DOC_NUMBER = #{docNumber}, TITLE = #{title}, REVISION_NO = #{revisionNo}, REVISION_DATE = #{revisionDate}, DOC_OWNER = #{owner}, FILE_LINK = #{fileLink}, NOTE = #{note, jdbcType=CLOB}, TAGS = #{tags}, UPDATED_AT = #{updatedAt} WHERE ID = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT d.ID FROM COMPANY_DOCUMENTS d WHERE d.TAGS IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM DOC_LAW_MAPPINGS m WHERE m.DOCUMENT_ID = d.ID)
